package.name: flutter_quill
package.reason: Maintained editor provides caret, range formatting, selection and IME without implementing a text engine. 11.5.1/11.6.0 require Flutter 3.44/Dart 3.12, so pin 11.5.0 on the existing SDK.

contracts: Optional content.richText = {version:1, delta:[insert-only text operations]}; document/project versions unchanged. Text projection is derived and validated against the existing text field.

Character attributes stay on text; paragraph alignment/direction/list attributes stay on newline operations. Only bundled Roboto/Noto Sans Arabic families, sizes 8..144, supported colors and safe http/https/mailto links accepted. Unsupported payloads fail before replacing the Board.

Legacy text without richText retains its existing renderer and serialized shape until actually edited. Older strict application readers reject new rich payloads safely; backward loading is supported, forward compatibility with old binaries is not promised.

One Quill controller per active element; 350 ms immutable checkpoints, revision-ordered existing autosave, one Board undo entry at commit. Text undo/redo stays local until commit; Escape restores original at a new revision.

Shared paragraph adapter paints canvas and PNG, including lists and RTL. Quill physical left/right alignment adapted only at the editing boundary; fonts, world transforms and uniform PNG Fit remain unchanged.

Text rectangle resizing changes wrap width/auto-height instead of stretching glyphs. Existing group transforms remain uniform. Caret visibility pans only the camera when keyboard constraints reduce the visible canvas.
Retry reconnects invalidated IndexedDB while preserving existing generation/CAS checks. No memory fallback or user-data deletion.

limitations: Physical Android/iOS/tablet keyboard, IME, touch selection handles, stylus and assistive technology require device qualification. Simulator/APK compilation alone is not a UI pass.
Windows/Linux and Safari/Edge rich-text runtime qualification remains separate; existing CI will run supported native jobs after push. No all-platform production-readiness claim.
External rich clipboard is deliberately plain text; no embeds, nested lists, headings/code blocks, custom fonts or external rich-paste interoperability. Links do not launch during editing.
Editor growth capped at 200,000 UTF-16 code units; document validation additionally caps 1,000,000 units/100,000 operations. Huge text and export peak memory are not newly benchmarked.
Synthetic composing-range tests are not physical IME certification. Actual Arabic input and shaping were observed on macOS/Chrome, not every keyboard/IME.
Dense 10,000-element performance and wider release signing/device gates unchanged. Earlier beta.4 downloads do not include this source milestone.
manual_check: Run flutter pub get, then flutter run -d macos or flutter run -d chrome. Select Text, click empty canvas, and type multiple Arabic/English lines.
Select a word and apply Bold; select a different word and choose color/size/highlight. Try alignment, RTL, numbered/bullet lists. Use Escape to cancel or click outside to commit.
Re-edit with a double click or Edit text action; resize wrap width, move/rotate, Undo/Redo. Wait for Saved locally, quit/reopen or reload.
Save As .wboard and import as an independent Board. Export viewport at 4K, then select an Export Frame and export custom dimensions with transparency. Open the actual files.
